bounded_observations: Sell fee CPI precedes payouts; cashback/creator payment precedes user payment; event emission follows payments.
Sell earned-cashback overflow occurs before later user/fee payouts; native and stable-quote panics identify volume_accumulator.rs lines 164 and 170 respectively.
Legacy wrong owner and bad/short discriminator return 6073 before cashback transfer; a valid eight-byte discriminator passes that guard and later reaches deserialization error 3003.
Empty/system-owned initialization performs transfer/allocate/assign; at the captured 1844400-lamport boundary the funding transfer disappears and CPI count drops from six to five.
runtime_evidence.limit: Captured observations constrain behavior only; they do not establish byte identity or historical source provenance. No runtime-cashback-partial dataset was used.
